IMPROVEMENT PROPOSALS:
- [immediate] Build minimal ingestion: webcam capture → timestamped frames → storage. Even 1fps is better than 0.
- [this-sprint] Pick easiest edge case and run targeted experiment. Suggestion: "southpaw stance detection unreliable"

PIPELINE ANALYSIS:
- [critical] Ingestion pipeline not processing any frames. All downstream projects starved of data.
- [medium] 4 known edge cases documented but zero experiments running to address them.
- [medium] Zero post-mortems. Lab is not learning from its own failures.

PRIORITY ASSIGNMENT:
[HIGH] build-ingestion → deployer: Ingestion pipeline not running. Everything downstream blocked on frame data.

PUBLIC PITCH: Three months from now you'll look back at your first video and see a completely different fighter. The system keeps everything — every session, every improvement, every setback. Your boxing history, measured and stored. Progress you can actually prove.
PUBLIC PITCH: Film yourself. Send the video. Get a report. That's it. Works on any phone. Takes about a minute to process. No app to download, no account to create, no subscription.

PUBLIC PITCH: Every punch tracker on the market straps something to your wrist. This watches your whole body — stance, guard, footwork, combinations — from a single camera. Nothing to wear. Nothing to charge. Just box.

PUBLIC PITCH: First session: baseline. Every session after: comparison. Are you throwing more? Harder? Keeping your guard higher? The system remembers what you did last time and shows you the difference. You can't lie to the data.

PUBLIC PITCH: Send us a video of your round. We count every punch, measure your guard, track your footwork. Not a guess — a measurement. You get back a report that shows exactly what happened. No wearable. No sensor. Just your phone camera.
